prisoner.name: Sally Kearsley
prisoner.description: Sally Kearsley was jailed during the 1981 anti-nuclear actions at the White House. The December 12, 1981 National No-Nukes Prison Support Collective newsletter identifies her among six Jonah House protesters held at the D.C. Detention Center and reports a thirty-day sentence connected with holding anti-nuclear banners. Her exact admission and release dates remain unverified.
prisoner.body: Source: National No-Nukes Prison Support Collective newsletter, December 12, 1981, page1. Historical custody is confirmed; present custody is not claimed.

case.charges: White House anti-nuclear banner protest; exact statutory charge unverified.
case.sentence: Thirty-day sentence; actual custody at D.C. Detention Center reported December 12, 1981. Exact admission and release days and actual total served remain unverified.
